verdict.rationale: Martin shows some many-items-at-once behavior: forwarding one email adds all its events to the calendar, background email triage labels incoming emails and takes follow-up actions automatically, shortcuts trigger multi-step actions, and to-dos can be imported in bulk from Todoist. However, there is no documented general bulk operation, such as editing, deleting, or moving many to-dos, notes, events, or messages in a single command. Missing for 10: explicit bulk edit/delete/update across arbitrary item sets, documented limits or scale for batch actions, hands-on corroboration of bulk actions working reliably.
